in_sanskrit.name: Naimul
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Radiant Moon
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Naimul एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। The name Naimul is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Naimitra' which means friend and 'Mool' which means root or source. The name Naimul signifies a radiant and powerful individual who is a source of inspiration and strength to his friends and loved ones.
